name: Photo Colour Treatments
description: Quick colour treatments for photo assets: greyscale plus soft two-colour duotone washes (shadow maps to shadows, highlight to highlights) and optional three-stop tritones (shadow → mid → highlight), plus two photo looks (OKLab gradient maps, baked into the pixels): Brand grade (Pine to Jungle 6 to White in light, Ultra Black to Pine to Mint in dark) and Pine to Mint, fitted to the graded photos of the Sleepwalking deck. Chosen at pick time and baked at resolve. 'None' is the plain photo (no id suffix).
